findings.claim: BOOTSTRAP_MAINTENANCE has contradictory attempt-accounting semantics: Section 5.1 forbids it from allocating a mission attempt, while Section 6.3 presents mission-attempt charging as the alternative to an explicitly authorized uncharged administrative exception.
findings.disposition_reason: Parent-confirmed high-severity overlapping bootstrap accounting contradiction requires revision.

findings.claim: v9 states that BOOTSTRAP_MAINTENANCE may not allocate a mission attempt, yet it also treats mission-attempt charging as the default bootstrap accounting mode and uncharged administrative accounting as the exception, so a bootstrap attempt charge could be taken or concealed outside the counted mission-attempt ledger.
